Different ways to run your finances, different ceilings

Every option works at some scale. The question is where it tops out.

Bar height is how much of your finance function each option actually carries.

DIY: spreadsheets plus a chat assistant

Free, flexible, and fine at the very start. You export CSVs, you categorize, you reconcile, you Google the tax deadline.

The Ceiling

It runs on founder time, the most expensive input in the company. Nothing happens unless you do it.

Outsourced bookkeeping services

Humans in a queue do the books for you, usually on their platform and their calendar.

The Ceiling

Turnaround is measured in weeks, scope stops at the bookkeeping, and tax, forecasting, and advisory are upsells handled by someone else.

  • Traditional accounting services

Hiring: in-house or fractional

Real judgment, real ownership. A controller or fractional CFO who knows your business.

The Ceiling

Linear cost against a shrinking talent pool, and your senior hire still spends most of the month preparing rather than advising.

  • Fractional CFOs, offshore teams

The AI CPA firm

AI agents execute the daily work: reconciliation, AP/AR, close, statements, and tax. A dedicated accountant and tax expert back them. Agents work inside the systems you already use, including bank portals with no API, and your team approves the output before it counts.

The Ceiling

Your books, always current. Your close, in hours. Your taxes, filed. Capacity that scales with your business instead of your headcount, and everything built remains your IP.

  • The execution layer

Keep QuickBooks. Keep your banks, your Brex or Ramp cards, your Stripe. Adopt runs on top of the stack you already have. No rip-and-replace.

Proven · Governed · Grounded

Built for the profession where "trust me" isn't an answer

Proven on your books

Before you rely on it, agents are scored against your own prior months' books, so you see the accuracy on your files first. The models write the logic; they never key the numbers themselves. Anything below your confidence threshold routes to a human with a link to the exact source document.

Governed at every step

Approval checkpoints wherever you choose to put them. Every action is time-stamped into an immutable audit trail: event logs, formula versions, and human-review records that travel with the work and hold up under examination.

Your data stays yours

Your financial data is logically isolated and never used to train models. Bring your own model keys. Deploy in the cloud, in your own VPC, or on-prem, so there is never a question about where your data went.

Zero training on customer data
